summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Spiranac’s Rule Blunder
items.text: Paige Spiranac admitted she was "painfully embarrassed" after being accused of cheating by stomping in high grass to aid a teammate at The Internet Invitational, revealing she didn’t know that action was against the rules.

items.headline: PGA Tour ‘Danger’ Over McIlroy
items.text: Golf Channel’s Ryan Lavner warned the PGA Tour it's in a "dangerous" position planning future events around Rory McIlroy, who prioritizes DP World Tour events and takes long breaks, limiting his starts with stars like Scottie Scheffler to only four times this year.
